```yaml
name: Duplicate Issue Detection

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  detect-duplicates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run duplicate detection
        id: detect_duplicates
        uses: wow-actions/potential-duplicates@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          similarity_threshold: 90
          labels: "potential-duplicate"

      - name: Add comment if duplicates found
        if: steps.detect_duplicates.outputs.duplicates_found == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "::add-comment::Potential duplicate issues found. Please review the suggested duplicates."
```
